name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v531: Completely automatic, invisible Cloudflare bypass — no buttons, no UI, no dialog. Invisible mode is now ON by default: when you open the app and the saved cookie is older than ~30 minutes, a headless WebView solves Cloudflare silently in the background, saves the cookie + solving UA under all AnimePahe domains (.pw, .org, .com, www.), then destroys itself. You just open the app and play — no pop-ups, no buttons, nothing to tap. The visible bottom sheet remains available only if you turn OFF "Hide Cloudflare WebView" in settings. All v530 fixes retained: lenient cf_clearance detection, cleaned UA consistency, cookie saved under all 8 hosts, probe throttle once per minute, skip probe when cookie fresh, stream-link cache ~20 min.
